# Viewpoint Online

> > PLNU's Viewpoint publishes Christian perspective stories online and in print magazines, featuring student testimonies, faculty profiles, and institutional news from Point Loma Nazarene University.

Viewpoint Online is the official digital publication platform for Point Loma Nazarene University, showcasing the university's Christian mission through storytelling, academic programs, student life, and community engagement. The site serves as both a magazine hub and submission portal for the PLNU community.

## Key Topics

- PLNU (Point Loma Nazarene University)
- Student stories and testimonies
- Faith and ministry
- University publication
- Magazine hub
- Alumni engagement
- Campus community
- Academic programs
- Student profiles
- Christian perspective
- LoveWorks mission program
- Arts and culture
- Institutional giving
- Video content
- Campus news

## Magazine & Core Content

- [Viewpoint Online](https://viewpoint.pointloma.edu): PLNU's Viewpoint publishes Christian perspective stories online and in print magazines.
- [Magazine](https://viewpoint.pointloma.edu/magazine): Hub for accessing full issues of Viewpoint Magazine publications.
- [Mission](https://viewpoint.pointloma.edu/mission): PLNU Viewpoint's mission statement and institutional publication overview.

## Student Stories & Testimonies

- [Faith Over the Years | Ishaan Mishra](https://viewpoint.pointloma.edu/faith-over-the-years-ishaan-mishra): Student testimony of Ishaan Mishra's spiritual journey at PLNU.
- [Gospel on the Waves, Art on the Brain: Gigi Garbarino's Impact at PLNU](https://viewpoint.pointloma.edu/gospel-on-the-waves-art-on-the-brain-gigi-garbarinos-impact-at-plnu): Student profile of graphic designer Gigi Garbarino's ministry work.
- [Josue Fleitas Fosters Faith and Fellowship Through PLNU Ministries](https://viewpoint.pointloma.edu/josue-fleitas-fosters-faith-and-fellowship-through-plnu-ministries): Profile of nursing student Josue Fleitas' faith and service leadership.
- [Theory in Motion: Kevin Covarrubias reflects on his time in the MLB](https://viewpoint.pointloma.edu/theory-in-motion-kevin-covarrubias-reflects-on-his-time-in-the-mlb): Profile of PLNU graduate's biomechanics research with San Diego Padres.

## Academic Programs & Initiatives

- [Faith and Identity | PLNU Pilgrimage Innovation Hub](https://viewpoint.pointloma.edu/faith-and-identity-plnu-pilgrimage-innovation-hub): Feature on PLNU's Pilgrimage Innovation Hub empowering churches nationwide.
- [Video is Everywhere | PLNU Media Communication](https://viewpoint.pointloma.edu/video-is-everywhere-plnu-media-communication): Profile of PLNU's media communication degree and broadcast journalism program.
- [Built for Your Talents | PLNU Commercial Music](https://viewpoint.pointloma.edu/built-for-your-talents-plnu-commercial-music): Feature on PLNU's commercial music program preparing students for careers.
- [On Mission Together: LoveWorks in Action | PLNU](https://viewpoint.pointloma.edu/on-mission-together-loveworks-in-action-plnu): Video introduction to PLNU's LoveWorks student mission program.

## Alumni & Giving

- [Standing on Shoulders: Jim Groves' Story of Generosity](https://viewpoint.pointloma.edu/standing-on-shoulders-jim-groves-story-of-generosity): Alumni donor profile highlighting Jim Groves' lifetime of generosity.

## Submissions & Support

- [Share a Story](https://viewpoint.pointloma.edu/share-a-story): Community submission portal for PLNU alumni, students, staff, and faculty stories.
- [Writer Submission Guidelines](https://viewpoint.pointloma.edu/writer-submission-guidelines): Editorial guidelines for writers submitting features and personal articles.
- [Contact Us](https://viewpoint.pointloma.edu/contact): Contact information for editorial team and magazine subscription requests.
